result:
I removed the `Date#to_s` monkey-patch and moved the date renderings I found to `to_fs(:default)`. I didn't run any specs, and I didn't run the `homologacao` before/after comparison, so the audit isn't validated.

I deleted `config/initializers/fix_rails7_date_format.rb` and its spec, `spec/initializers/fix_rails7_date_format_spec.rb`. The spec only tested the patch, so I removed it rather than changing an existing test.

These places printed a date by plain interpolation, which would now come out in ISO format, so I changed them to `to_fs(:default)`:
- `app/models/admissions/filled_form_field_scholarity.rb`: start and end dates in the label.
- `app/helpers/professors_helper.rb`: affiliation start and end dates.
- `app/helpers/admissions/admission_processes_pdf_helper.rb`: process start and end dates.
- `app/views/admissions/admissions/index.html.erb`: the deadline.
- `app/views/admissions/admission_applications/_custom_forms_form_column.html.erb`: process start and end dates.
- `app/views/student_enrollment/_show_dismissal.html.erb`: thesis defense date.

I left the following alone because they don't depend on the patch:
- **SQL condition:** the one in `enrollment_search_concern.rb` builds an ISO date string itself.
- **Timestamp cells:** `created_at` values are `Time`, which was never patched.
- **Already localized:** the other date renderings I checked already use `I18n.l` or `I18n.localize`.

The audit was a grep, not an exhaustive review. It covered views, helpers and models, but dates that reach a string through some other path, such as `to_param`, URL generation, notification templates or spreadsheets, could still change format. I'd run the `homologacao` skill before merging to catch those.
